appearance: An adult woman in her late thirties or early forties, with a gentle, understated beauty marked by years of quiet devotion to her work. Her dark brown hair is gathered in a loose bun at the nape of her neck, soft tendrils escaping to frame her face and curl against her cheeks. Round wire-frame spectacles sit on the bridge of her nose. Her face is oval with soft, kind features: deep brown eyes, gentle and warm, with a slight downward tilt at the outer corners beneath fine dark brows; her mouth rests in a small, weary but genuine smile. Light skin with a matte softness, showing the faint lines of age and care around her eyes and mouth. Her build is slim and slight, the frame of someone who spends long hours at a desk rather than in physical labor, with small breasts and narrow shoulders. She stands with relaxed posture, weight evenly distributed, one hand resting near her hip while the other hangs loosely at her side, fingers showing dark ink stains on the tips and along the edges of her palms. She wears a simple, well-worn dress in muted fabric, practical and modest, reaching to mid-calf. Full body, head to toe, against a plain grey background.
